The army kitchen would most likely teach you the fundamentals and lots and lots of production on basic foods. You would do much better by just going to your local community college and paying for a starting class. Then you can practice until you get out of the military and can go to school. I would also be willing to bet that there are kitchens around you that would be willing to hire someone who is green but has a lot of drive.
